source_title: Veterinary Medicines Formulary — Tanzania Small Ruminants

chunks.text: Oxytetracycline Long Acting: Generic name: Oxytetracycline dihydrate. Brands in Tanzania: Alamycin LA (Norbrook), Terramycin LA (Zoetis), Oxytet 200 LA. Mechanism: bacteriostatic antibiotic inhibiting protein synthesis. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: respiratory infections (pneumonia, CCPP), footrot, wound infections, enteritis. Dosage: 20 mg/kg body weight by deep intramuscular injection. For a 30kg goat: 3 ml of 200 mg/ml formulation. Route: IM only — deep into neck or thigh muscle. Frequency: single injection, repeat after 48-72 hours if needed. Treatment duration: 3-5 days for standard infections.

Ivermectin: Generic name: Ivermectin. Brands in Tanzania: Ivomec (Merial), Bimectin (Bimeda), Noromectin (Norbrook). Mechanism: macrocyclic lactone — binds glutamate-gated chloride channels causing paralysis of parasites. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: internal parasites (Haemonchus contortus, Trichostrongylus, Ostertagia), external parasites (mange mites, lice, nasal bot). Dosage: 0.2 mg/kg body weight. For 10mg/ml injectable: 0.02 ml/kg. For a 30kg goat: 0.6 ml. Route: subcutaneous (SC) injection behind ear or in axilla. Pour-on: 0.5 mg/kg along back. Meat withdrawal: 28 days. Milk withdrawal: do not use milk from lactating goats being treated for human consumption.

Albendazole: Generic name: Albendazole. Brands in Tanzania: Valbazen (Zoetis), Alben (Chanelle). Mechanism: benzimidazole — inhibits microtubule polymerisation in parasites. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: gastrointestinal roundworms, liver fluke (Fasciola), tapeworms (Moniezia). Dosage: 10 mg/kg body weight orally. For a 30kg goat: 300 mg (typically 3 ml of 100 mg/ml oral suspension). Route: oral drench. Meat withdrawal: 14 days. Milk withdrawal: 4 days. Contraindications: do not use in first month of pregnancy. Do not use in severely debilitated animals. Drug rotation note: alternate with ivermectin or levamisole to prevent resistance.

Levamisole: Generic name: Levamisole hydrochloride. Brands in Tanzania: Levasole (Merck), Nilverm (MSD). Mechanism: imidazothiazole — nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist causing paralysis of parasites. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: gastrointestinal roundworms (Haemonchus, Trichostrongylus, Cooperia, Oesophagostomum). Dosage: 8 mg/kg orally or 7.5 mg/kg subcutaneously. For oral solution (13.65% w/v): 0.6 ml per 10kg body weight. Route: oral drench preferred, SC injection acceptable. Meat withdrawal: 7 days. Milk withdrawal: 4 days. Safety margin narrow — accurate dosing critical. Do not exceed recommended dose. Do not combine with organophosphate anthelmintics.

Procaine Penicillin: Generic name: Procaine benzylpenicillin. Brands in Tanzania: Penstrep (Norbrook), Depomycin (Intervet). Mechanism: beta-lactam bactericidal — inhibits cell wall synthesis. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: wound infections, footrot, navel ill in kids, metritis, mastitis (systemic). Dosage: 22,000 IU/kg body weight by intramuscular injection. For 300,000 IU/ml: 0.07 ml/kg. For a 30kg goat: 2.2 ml. Route: deep IM. Frequency: once daily for 3-5 days. Meat withdrawal: 14 days. Milk withdrawal: 4 days. Note: not effective against gram-negative bacteria. Combine with streptomycin for broader spectrum (Pen-Strep combination).

Enrofloxacin: Generic name: Enrofloxacin. Brands in Tanzania: Baytril (Bayer), Enroxil (KRKA). Mechanism: fluoroquinolone — inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: severe respiratory infections, enteritis, urinary tract infections when other antibiotics fail. Dosage: 5 mg/kg body weight subcutaneously. For a 30kg goat: 1.5 ml of 100 mg/ml. Route: SC injection. Frequency: once daily for 3-5 days. Meat withdrawal: 14 days. Milk withdrawal: 7 days. Important: reserve for cases where first-line antibiotics (oxytetracycline, penicillin) have failed. Do not use in food animals prophylactically.

Diminazene Aceturate (Berenil): Generic name: Diminazene aceturate. Brands in Tanzania: Berenil (Intervet), Trypazin (Norbrook). Mechanism: diamidine — binds to kinetoplast DNA of trypanosomes and piroplasms. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: trypanosomiasis (nagana), babesiosis (redwater). Dosage: 3.5 mg/kg body weight by deep IM injection (7 mg/kg for babesiosis). For a 30kg goat: 1.05 ml of 70 mg/ml solution. Route: deep IM, maximum 10ml per injection site. Single dose usually sufficient. Meat withdrawal: 21 days. Milk withdrawal: 7 days. Caution: do not combine with other trypanocidal drugs. Signs of toxicity: tremors, ataxia, facial oedema.

Dexamethasone: Generic name: Dexamethasone sodium phosphate. Brands in Tanzania: Dexafort (Intervet), Rapidexon (MSD). Mechanism: potent synthetic glucocorticoid — anti-inflammatory, immunosuppressive. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: severe inflammation, allergic reactions, shock, ketosis, pregnancy toxaemia. Dosage: 0.1-0.2 mg/kg body weight. For 2 mg/ml: 0.05-0.1 ml/kg. For a 30kg goat: 1.5-3 ml. Route: IM or slow IV. Frequency: single dose or once daily for 2-3 days. Meat withdrawal: 7 days. Milk withdrawal: 3 days. Contraindications: do not use in last month of pregnancy (may cause parturition). Do not use with NSAIDs simultaneously. Use short courses only.

Calcium Borogluconate 40%: Generic name: Calcium borogluconate. Brands in Tanzania: Calciject (Norbrook), Calphosan (Bimeda). Mechanism: corrects hypocalcaemia by providing ionized calcium. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: milk fever (hypocalcaemia), pregnancy toxaemia supportive care, transport tetany. Dosage: 100-200 ml of 20% or 50-100 ml of 40% solution subcutaneously or intravenously. Route: slow IV (not faster than 1ml per 2kg per minute) or SC in multiple sites. Warm to body temperature before injection. Heart monitoring required during IV administration. Meat withdrawal: zero days. Milk withdrawal: zero days. Also available with phosphorus and magnesium (CMPK solutions) for complex deficiencies.

Flunixin Meglumine (Finadyne): Generic name: Flunixin meglumine. Brands in Tanzania: Finadyne (MSD), Flunixamine (Bimeda). Mechanism: NSAID — non-selective COX inhibitor with anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects. Approved for goats and sheep. Indications: pain and inflammation control post-surgery, colic, musculoskeletal injuries, fever reduction. Dosage: 1.1-2.2 mg/kg body weight (1-2 ml of 50 mg/ml per 25kg). Route: IV or IM. Frequency: once daily for 3 days maximum. Meat withdrawal: 7 days. Milk withdrawal: 2 days. Do not use with corticosteroids or other NSAIDs. Do not use in dehydrated animals. Reserve for cases where paracetamol or aspirin are insufficient.
